metadata.title: Generalized scalar curvature and Ricci flow on compact Lie groups
metadata.abstract: Let $G$ be a compact connected semisimple Lie group, let $Q$ be a bi-invariant metric and let $\rho$ be its Cartan three-form. We prove that every left-invariant generalized Ricci flow with $[H_0]=[\rho]$ exists for all positive time and converges smoothly to a Bismut-Ricci-flat pair without rescaling or pullback. The standard pair uniquely maximizes generalized scalar curvature in its torsion class, and every left-invariant Bismut-Ricci-flat pair on a compact simple group is standard, answering questions of Fusi, Lafuente and Stanfield and of Lauret and Will. On the product of two copies of a compact simple group, nonstandard stationary pairs in the Cartan class are known; we construct nonstationary flows with the exact initial form $[H_0]=[\rho]$ and nonstandard limits, disproving the general semisimple case of the convergence conjecture of Garcia-Fernandez and Streets. The proofs use a proper nonincreasing energy and a decomposition of Killing fields that parametrizes the stationary pairs by nilpotent Lie algebra endomorphisms.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 紧 Lie 群的广义 Ricci 流极限
analysis.workSummary: 对紧连通半单群和 positive bi-invariant Q 的 Cartan 三形式，证明左不变广义 Ricci 流在 [H₀]=±[ρ] 下长时存在、轨道紧且未经 rescaling/pullback 光滑收敛至 BRF。standard pair 唯一达到 generalized scalar 的 c_Q/6 上界；简单群 BRF 全为 scaled standard。幂零 Lie 代数 endomorphism 参数化解释乘积群非标准 stationary pair。
techniques: 幂零 Lie 代数 endomorphism
analysis.breakthrough: 同时给出简单群刚性与一般半单群收敛猜想的反例。
analysis.limitations: ± 符号在全部简单因子上共同选取，Q 可有独立正尺度；scalar 最大化不需体积归一或 H harmonic。简单群全分类与一般半单群非标准极限不同，后者不能宣称 standard 收敛。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 OpenAI Codex 辅助文献搜索、数学论证及计算的草拟和检查，以及结构组织和语言改善。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.03795v1 · PDF 第 34 页，生成式 AI 声明
